title: Monotonicity of bounded walks
statement: Let $E$ be a binary relation on the natural numbers and let $n,j,k,c,t\in\mathbb{N}$. If $j\le k$ and there is a walk from $c$ to $t$ of length at most $j$, with every intermediate vertex less than $n$ and each step related by $E$, then there is such a walk of length at most $k$. A walk of length at most $j$ here means equality when $j=0$, and for a positive bound either equality or an initial step to some $v<n$ with $E(c,v)$ followed by a walk of length at most $j-1$ from $v$ to $t$.
hypotheses_covered: there is a bounded walk from $c$ to $t$
